name: cell: no applicable item is not comparable
cell: equal and na pass
cell: a missing item fails
cell: an unknown status is refused
styleEq: exact decimals, the tolerance 1/1000 is inclusive
tally: an empty block is not-run; an empty sweep is not comparable
state: units shifted with their box, same colors: every row passes; the skipped width and animation never fail
state: a unit moved 0.75 px against its box, a color differs, Lean's value differs on both arms
state: no vector (expect and expectNeutral null): the Lean row is not comparable; orig and rewrite disagree
state: an unknown part is refused
state: a skip set without a reason is refused

response.error: anchors: a skip or role without a reason, or an unknown skip set or box reference

name: stale: the box moved after the sweep, against a fresh load
tally: unreachable verdicts count neither pass nor fail; an all-unreachable cell is unreachable
state: a fractional width on WebKit (Apple) is unreachable: every row, the verdict, and no failing item
state: the same fractional state on Chromium is reachable (600.5 x 2 is whole) and fails
state: hover with a coarse pointer on WebKit (GLib) is unreachable by its primary pair
state: a part failure fails the state verdict even when every matchMedia row passes
state: an unknown port is refused
reach: every matrix probe on Chromium (all reachable)
reach: every matrix probe on WebKit (Apple): the fractional and cross probes are unreachable
reach: every matrix probe on WebKit (GLib): the fractional and cross probes are unreachable
state, variant strip: the faces are not judged; 2 strips against the original's 2 digits pass
state, variant strip: 3 strips against the original's 2 digits fail on the strip count
state, variant faithful (no variant role): the face count 20 against 0 fails
state, no variants field: the plain roles are judged
state: a variant role whose new role name is already a role is refused

response.error: anchors: part c: a variant role without a variant or a reason, an unknown replaced or counted role, or a new role name in use
